description: This file defines a React functional component named PremiumMCPSelector that renders a UI for selecting MCP servers with premium access control. If the user doesn't have a premium subscription, it shows a message with an upgrade link; otherwise, it renders the MCPServerSelector component.

methods.name: PremiumMCPSelector
methods.description: React functional component that displays either a premium access message or a server selector based on user premium status.
